messages:
aparna: heads-up: noticed older optimize docs still reference the legacy QuantProfile and batch_size keys. snippet CI flagged two failing examples in optimize/guides.

jess: which files? can you paste the CI snippet failures?

aparna: optimize/quantization-guide.md and optimize/batching-best-practices.md. snippet-runner shows Java NoClassDefFoundError and node example using batch_size.

samir: quick grep: `com.redwood.optimize.QuantProfile` appears in 3 snippets. runtime now exposes profiles under `com.redwood.optimize.profiles` and the config key is `max_batch_tokens`.

joe: (noted in person) we should add a short migration blurb and example showing the new imports for Java, and an equivalent node/python snippet.

jess: I'll prepare a docs-only PR that: updates snippets, adds a migration note under Optimize -> Migration, and introduces a small CI grep that fails if the old import appears.

zoe: FYI found a tiny edgecase: the caching.md example has an indented fence that breaks the harness. I'll fix formatting as part of the PR.

matt: suggest keeping changes minimal: replace imports and config keys, add migration section, run snippet harness locally before opening PR. also add a test exempt list for archived examples.

jess: working branch: fix/docs-quant-batch-2026. planned changes:
- Java example: `import com.redwood.optimize.profiles.QuantProfileV2;` and `QuantProfileV2 qp = QuantProfileV2.fromPreset("int8_low_mem");`
- Node: `const { QuantProfile } = require('@redwood/optimize/profiles');`
- YAML batching: replace `batch_size` with `max_batch_tokens` and add `timeout_ms`.
- Migration note: 2-3 lines with before/after snippets.

samir: running: `tools/snippet-runner --path docs/optimize --langs java,node,py` locally now. found the fence in caching.md; pushed a formatting tweak.

docs-bot: CI: docs-site / build (failed)  snippet tests reported NoClassDefFoundError in java example.

jess: pushed import fix and rebased. added grep CI check that fails on `com.redwood.optimize.QuantProfile`.

docs-bot: CI: docs-site / build (pending)  running snippet runner.

jess: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pull/4233  includes snippet fixes, migration note, YAML updates, caching MD formatting, and grep check.

matt: can we also add a one-liner to the Optimize README noting the change so customers see it in release notes?

aparna: yes please add to changelog and ping product for release highlights.

samir: local harness: all snippets pass after fixes. will run again on merge commit.

docs-bot: CI: docs-site / build (success)  snippet tests passed.

jess: merged PR 4233. changelog entry added under v2026.03. small CI lint added to prevent regression.

zoe: thanks all. leaving a follow-up to audit archived docs for legacy imports next sprint.

aparna: great work :rocket:
